tech.title: Tech & Project
tech.subtitle: About the project
tech.desc1: Transcendence is a modern reinterpretation of the classic Pong experience, combining competitive gameplay, a retro arcade spirit, and an immersive 3D hub. The project mixes frontend, backend, real-time interaction and visual design to create a complete digital experience where users can explore, play, compete and connect inside the same platform.
tech.desc2: The goal was not only to build a game, but to create a full universe around it: a navigable 3D environment, a polished interface, structured backend logic, auth system, game modes, and a visual identity inspired by futuristic arcade culture.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: Transcendence is a final project developed by four students at 42 Málaga. It includes a 3D hub, a competitive Pong game and user accounts. This is an academic project, not a commercial product.
privacy.s2Text: We store your username, email address, hashed password, game statistics and a session token. No payment or location data is collected.
privacy.s3Text: Solely to run the application — authentication, profiles and game features. We do not share or sell your data with anyone.
privacy.s4Text: We use a single session cookie to keep you logged in. No tracking or advertising cookies. Logging out removes it immediately.
privacy.s5Text: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and the application runs in an isolated Docker environment. This is a student project — avoid reusing passwords from other services.
privacy.s6Text: You can log in using your 42 account via OAuth. In that case, we only receive your 42 username and ID. We do not have access to your 42 password or any other data from their platform.
privacy.s7Text: You can delete your account at any time from the settings page. All associated data will be permanently removed.
privacy.s8Text: This application is intended for 42 Málaga students and evaluators. Access outside that context is not officially supported.

terms.s1Text: Transcendence is an academic project developed by four students at 42 Málaga. By using the platform you accept these terms. This is not a commercial service.
terms.s2Text: This platform is intended for 42 Málaga students and evaluators. Access outside that context is not officially supported.
terms.s3Text: You are responsible for your account and credentials. Do not share your password. Any activity under your account is your responsibility.
terms.s4Text: Do not attempt to exploit the platform, harass other users or use automated tools to interact with the service. Play fair.
terms.s5Text: Usernames and profile content must not be offensive or discriminatory. We may remove accounts that violate this.
terms.s6Text: This is a student project with no uptime guarantee. The service may go offline or change at any time.
terms.s7Text: Transcendence is an educational project. We are not liable for data loss, service interruptions or any damages arising from its use.
terms.s8Text: You can delete your account at any time from the settings page. Accounts that violate these terms may be removed without notice.
